d: Dipavli yani khushiyon ka tyohar. gharon men roshni, bachchon ki khilkhilahat, mithaiyon ki khushbu aur apnon ke sath vakt bitane ka mauka. lekin is tyohar par kuchh aise log bhi hain, jinki dipavli aspatal ki chardivari ke bich gujarti hai. jab pura shahar apne parivar ke sath dipavli mana raha hota hai, tab aspatal ke doktar, nars aur medikal staph kisi ki jindgi bachane men jute hote hain.kisi ke ghar men khushiyan lautane ki koshish, to kisi parivar ki bujhti ummid ko phir se roshan karne ki jimmedari. inke apne bachche hain, parivar hai aur dipavli manane ki khvahish bhi. lekin…
